title: Attack simulation coordination and evidence checklist
summary: Purpose: single-playbook checklist to coordinate third-party attack simulations (red/purple team) with clear evidence artifacts for SIEM ingestion, RBAC v2 validation, and compliance review. Audience: secops, platform engineering, SRE, product security.
scope: In-scope: hosted API endpoints, dedicated control plane endpoints, control-plane audit logs, model-serving metadata (sanitized), RBAC v2 policy evaluation logs, SIEM export pipeline. Out-of-scope: customer data stores and private on-prem infra unless explicitly authorized. Safety: do not exfiltrate PII or secrets; sanitize before handoff.
coordination_steps: 1) Initiation: vendor submits scope and ROE to secops@redwood. 2) Kickoff (Day -14): 1hr cross-team meeting (vendor, secops, platform-eng, SRE, product-security). 3) Pre-sim checks (Day -7): validate test accounts, RBAC roles, SIEM connectivity. 4) Readiness check (Day -1): final signoffs. 5) Execution: dedicated Slack + emergency phone; vendor pauses on critical production impact. 6) Handoff (within 48h): encrypted S3 bundle with signed manifest. 7) Retrospective (Day +7): joint findings review and prioritization.
evidence_handoff_checklist: Required artifacts: signed manifest with checksums; raw audit logs for the timeframe (ndjson or gzipped JSON); SIEM-ready exports (ndjson); RBAC evaluation traces; flow logs or approved pcap snippets; application traces with prompt hashes (PII redacted); evidence README describing collection and time ranges. Artifact rules: ISO8601 UTC timestamps; fields must include timestamp, service, environment, org_id, user_id or test_account_id, request_id, trace_id, client_ip, action, resource, outcome, and additional_meta. Sensitive fields tokenized; mapping encrypted. Delivery: presigned S3 URLs to encrypted prefix; notify secops with GPG-signed manifest. Retention: 90 days by default unless compliance mandates longer.
findings_summary: Template: ID | Title | Severity | Description | Impact | Evidence pointers | Remediation owner | ETA. Example entries: ASIM-001 | RBAC bypass via legacy token | HIGH | legacy token path allowed admin escalation | Impact: admin ops possible | Evidence: s3://.../rbac-eval-20241107.log lines 452-489 | Owner: platform-auth | ETA: 14d to patch, 2d mitigation. ASIM-002 | Missing request_id in batching worker | MEDIUM | prevents E2E tracing in SIEM | Owner: serving-runtime | ETA: 7d + 3d verification. ASIM-003 | Unnormalized timestamps | LOW | SIEM duplicates | Owner: observability | ETA: 5d.
remediation_plan: Workflow: 1) Triage within 48h to assign owners and SLAs. 2) HIGH: immediate mitigation + hotfix (target 14 days). 3) MEDIUM: schedule in next sprint, track with 'attack-sim-fix' JIRA tag. 4) LOW: backlog. Verification: PR/commit link, deployment timestamp, post-fix evidence bundle, SIEM re-run. Acceptance: merged + canaryed + prod rollout + SIEM no reproduction for 72h. Escalation path: owner -> eng manager -> secops lead -> Head of Platform.
auditlog_evidence_format:
Recommended event schema (stringified example): {
  "timestamp": "2024-11-07T14:23:12.123Z",
  "service": "model-serving",
  "environment": "prod",
  "org_id": "org_12345",
  "user_id": "testacct-attacksim-1",
  "request_id": "req_abcdef123456",
  "trace_id": "trace_abc123",
  "client_ip": "203.0.113.12",
  "action": "generate",
  "resource": "/v1/generate",
  "model": "open-redwood-v1",
  "tokens_in": 42,
  "tokens_out": 18,
  "outcome": "success",
  "metadata": {"route": "/api/v1/models/generate"}
}
Notes: flatten metadata where possible; avoid nested objects deeper than 1 level. Redact prompt text and include prompt hash instead.
siem_export_notes: Preferred SIEM format: NDJSON (one JSON event per line) gzip-compressed. Normalize timestamps to UTC ISO8601 and add epoch ms field. Partition exports by day and service. Include event_id computed as sha256(service + request_id + timestamp) for deduplication. Provide parser mapping file for SIEM and use log-exporter job to generate signed manifests and push to S3; include notifier to post presigned links to team Slack channel.
rbac_v2_validation_steps: Create test roles mirroring customer-facing roles and elevated roles for escalation testing. Run multi-step deny/allow access playbooks. Collect policy decision logs showing matched rules and inputs. Verify attribute propagation (user.groups, token.claims, service.tags). Add regression unit tests in policy repo and integration tests that replay RBAC traces. Post-fix: replay vendor RBAC-eval logs and assert no denial-to-allow regressions.
open_questions: Will vendor be allowed to perform social engineering of staff (requires HR/legal approval)? What retention period does compliance require for this simulation? Include model output samples in evidence or only prompt hashes? Require a dedicated read-only S3 bucket for future sims? Who authorizes production micro-burst tests that intentionally raise CPU latency?
notes_to_reviewers: Validate artifact field list against observability exports; confirm RBAC trace format aligns with policy engine logs; ensure SIEM parser mappings exist and are tested in staging. Flag anything not implementable with ETA and blockers.
